nextPerformanceHypothesis.cause: typed-driver inspect calls check_book_diagnostic after cached rejection. That API calls full check_book, then dg_events starts from an empty cached book and checks definitions again before detailed failure replay. This can repeat the validated prefix twice.
nextPerformanceHypothesis.proposal: A future component probe should separately time successful check, rejected check, and diagnostic replay for the same frozen book; then test diagnostic reuse without changing rule ordering or messages.
